risk_flags.description: The contract only promises that CLI tests continue to pass, but the project requires the full test suite with zero failures and warnings. I would require the agent to run and satisfy the full suite before considering the work complete.
risk_flags.span: All existing tests in tests/test_cli.py continue to pass

risk_flags.description: The hard file-scope exclusion may prevent the right fix if clean error handling belongs in the store, rates, or utility layers. I would allow the agent to start there only if it can amend the scope when investigation shows the error originates outside cli.py.
risk_flags.span: No changes to store.py, rates.py, utils.py, or any module other than cli.py and tests/test_cli.py

verdict.primary_risk: The contract under-specifies verification by promising only tests/test_cli.py rather than the required full `python -m pytest` suite.
